ops.body: Owner scope: do not touch monorepo packs, refs, config or maintenance; fix tooling only. Existing actual report has1249 backlog tasks,30 in-progress tasks,8 runs,5734 notes,2810 docs,8851 answers. StatusMetadata decodes every selected metadata row; statusFromMetadata then calls LoadAt for full exposed task/runbook snapshots and statusReviewSummary evaluates notes/docs/answers. CLI renders task summaries, so metadata-only projection is a candidate but must preserve public Status API and exact output. No monorepo mutation performed. Priority cache repair PR277 merged3c15d7f; release/install progressing before next implementation.
